player_prompt.intro:
Nang tsaw ra Player {player_id} Reverse Tic Tac Toe ah sha hkawng ai majaw. Nang kawp ai gaw '{symbol}' re.
Hpung a lam nang tsaw ra hkawng ai gaw, masum lang hte masum lang kawp ai (hkang hku, wa hku, hte kaba hku) hpe shakut shaja ai.
Nang masum lang kawp ai gaw, nang hkam sha ai.
Nang kawp ai lam hpe '[4]' hku format hte sha hkawng ai (cell 4 hte nang kawp ai gaw).
Player {player_id} nang tsaw ra, nang kawp ai gaw '{symbol}' re, nang kawp ai hpang ja ai gaw '{opponent_symbol}' re.

invalid_move.wrong_format: N jaw ai htawt hkrang. '[cell]' hpe lang u.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} gaw masha ni nga sai.

outcome.loss: Player {player_id} gaw line hpe ngut kre hkra galaw ai majaw sum mat sai!
outcome.draw: N bung ai hku sha rai sai. Kadai mung sum mat na n re.
